Livermore's budget as bars

Where the money comes from and where it goes, each a list of bars on one scale, largest first, opening in place into the parts the budget prints. Drawn from the FY 2026-27 adopted budget.

How to read this page

Each side is a list of bars, largest first, every bar on the one scale the page's largest bar sets. Click a bar that opens to see its parts under it, indented; click it again to close it. Shift-click opens a bar its other way where the budget prints one. A bar marked inferred is a figure the city prints only as a difference; one with a leading minus is printed as a reduction and counts against its parent. Every other figure adds up numbers the city printed, and pointing at a bar, or focusing it, names the pages it was read from. A share marked ◇ is ours: one bar as a percentage of its side.

  • opens with a click
  • opened; a click closes it
  • printed as a reduction, drawn at its size
  • inferred: printed only as a difference
